# Analyse Système et Exigences

## Introduction du chapitre

Ce chapitre est en cours de rédaction.

```{.plantuml width=100%}
@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

' ================= ENUMS =================
enum PFEType {
  INTERNAL
  EXTERNAL
}

enum PFEStatus {
  DRAFT
  FICHE_PENDING_VALIDATION
  VALIDATED
  REJECTED
  IN_PROGRESS
  SUBMITTED
  UNDER_EVALUATION
  ADMITTED
  FAILED
  CORRECTION_REQUIRED
  PUBLISHED
}

enum EvaluationResult {
  ADMITTED
  NOT_ADMITTED
  CORRECTION_REQUIRED
}

' ================= CORE ACTORS =================
class Student {
  +id: String
  +fullName: String
  +dob: Date
  +speciality: String
}

class Teacher {
  +id: String
  +fullName: String
  +department: String
}

class Company {
  +id: String
  +name: String
}

' ================= PFE =================
class PFE {
  +code: String
  +title: String
  +type: PFEType
  +status: PFEStatus
  +deadline: Date
  +submit()
  +validateFiche()
  +assignCode()
  +publish()
}

class CoPromoteur {
  +id: String
  +name: String
}

PFE "1" -- "1" Student : assigned to >
PFE "1" -- "1" Teacher : encadrant >
PFE "0..1" -- "1" Company : external >
PFE "0..1" -- "1" CoPromoteur : external only >

' ================= FICHE PFE =================
class FichePFE {
  +id: String
  +submittedAt: Date
  +isValid: Boolean
  +validate()
  +requestChanges()
}

PFE "1" o-- "1" FichePFE

Teacher --> FichePFE : signs
Student --> FichePFE : fills
FichePFE --> Teacher : encadrant validation
FichePFE --> Administration : submitted to

class Administration {
  +id: String
  +validateFiche()
  +assignCode()
  +assignJury()
  +assignRoom()
  +assignSchedule()
}

' ================= FOLLOW-UP =================
class FicheSuiviPFE {
  +id: String
  +meetingDate: Date
  +progressNotes: String
  +teacherFeedback: String
  +studentNotes: String
}

PFE "1" o-- "0..*" FicheSuiviPFE
Student --> FicheSuiviPFE : fills
Teacher --> FicheSuiviPFE : reviews

' ================= JURY SYSTEM =================
class Jury {
  +id: String
}

class JuryMember {
  +role: String  ' President / Member
}

Teacher "0..*" -- "0..*" JuryMember
Jury "1" o-- "1..3" JuryMember
PFE "1" -- "1" Jury

Administration --> Jury : assigns

' ================= EVALUATION =================
class Evaluation {
  +id: String
  +date: Date
  +result: EvaluationResult
  +score: float
  +comment: String
  +evaluate()
}

Jury "1" -- "1" Evaluation
PFE "1" -- "0..1" Evaluation

Evaluation --> PFE : evaluates

' ================= LOGISTICS =================
class Schedule {
  +date: Date
  +time: Time
}

class Room {
  +number: String
  +building: String
}

PFE "1" -- "1" Schedule
PFE "1" -- "1" Room

Administration --> Schedule : assigns
Administration --> Room : assigns

' ================= NOTIFICATIONS =================
class NotificationService {
  +sendToStudent()
  +sendToTeachers()
}

Administration --> NotificationService : triggers
NotificationService --> Student
NotificationService --> Teacher

@enduml
```
